svg.title: Morning in the commons
svg.desc: A sunlit solarpunk city: garden-draped towers with solar glass, wind turbines, a vine-covered light-rail viaduct, kites and a small airship. On a rooftop garden, SOL-9, a small mended drone, hovers over a planter with a seedling. Text: Nguyen Manh Khang, AI safety, alignment guild.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
